question: Hockey India, under the Ministry of _______, is the governing body responsible for planning and implementing all activities related to men's and women's hockey in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Youth Affairs and Sports**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hockey India, under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, is the governing body responsible for planning and implementing all activities related to men's and women's hockey in India.
 
• **Hockey India was formed in 2009 t**o replace the Indian Hockey Federation, which faced various administrative and governance issues
 
• It is affiliated with the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**, which governs the rules and regulations of the sport globally
 
• The organization selects and manages the Indian national teams for various international competitions, including the **Olympics**, **World Cup**, **Hockey World League**, and **Asian Games**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Education**

 
 
• **​**The **Ministry of Education is responsible for formulating and implementing educational policies and programs in India.**
 
• It oversees primary, secondary, and higher education, focusing on improving educational access and quality.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Child Development****​**
 
 
• This ministry **focuses on the welfare and development of children in India**, addressing issues related to nutrition, education, health, and protection.
 
• It implements programs aimed at improving the well-being of children, such as the **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)** scheme.
 
• The ministry also works on policies for child rights and protection, addressing child labor, and ensuring access to education and healthcare for children.
